world.label: Orchard interface fixture
world.summary: One worker can eventually pick ripe fruit from a represented tree.

actor_information.public_summary: A public orchard used only for interface verification.

mechanics.rationale: A worker can take a ripe fruit in the same place; the fruit becomes picked and owned by that worker.
